title: Deny-by-default synthetic input surface for agent-assisted QA
description: A new operator-gated surface that lets an agent driving the API inject synthetic pointer (move/click/drag) and keyboard (press/text entry) and scroll input into the live GUI, exactly mirroring the existing screenshot surface's posture: FE_API_INPUT_ALLOW=1 opt-in, Owner-only, rate-limited, via the shared OperatorGate chain. Commands cross a new bounded fe-runtime channel into Bevy and are translated into real input early in the frame so bevy_egui's own input collection sees them; a deterministic wait-for-N-frames settle plus an optional post-action screenshot let an agent inject a click and immediately see the result in one correlated round trip. Never wired on the headless relay (no window). Framed publicly as agent-assisted QA / accessibility automation.
